features: Create an original wall display with this easy-to-hang, pre-drilled shelving solution
Includes set of three U-shaped floating wall shelves measuring 12", 16" and 20" (L) by 6" (D) by 6" (H)

description: Showcase cherished photos, keepsakes and other decorative items on this functional and attractive shelving solution. Includes set of three U-shaped floating wall shelves measuring 20", 16" and 12" long. Display area of the shelf is 5.9" deep. Featuring a contemporary Gray finish to complement virtually any home or office decor. Included installation hardware makes for easy wall mounting, with no visible wiring or hardware connections.
